name: zvideo_dd_create_surface3_from_desc
description: zVideo_dd::CreateSurface3FromDesc creates an IDirectDrawSurface from an IDirectDraw2 descriptor, queries IDirectDrawSurface3, and releases the temporary base surface on successful QueryInterface.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4a88b0 validates fastcall ECX=IDirectDraw2, EDX=DDSURFACEDESC, stack outSurface plus one unused zero stack argument, provider CreateSurface(desc, &createdSurface, 0), QueryInterface(IID_IDirectDrawSurface3, outSurface) only after CreateSurface succeeds, Release of the temporary base surface only after QueryInterface succeeds, ret 8 stack cleanup, and returning the current provider result.
Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x4a88b0 has no warnings and matches the implemented CreateSurface, QueryInterface, conditional Release, and result propagation.

The native smoke verifies the success path passes the descriptor and null outer pointer to CreateSurface, queries IID_IDirectDrawSurface3 into the caller's out pointer, releases the temporary base surface, returns DD_OK when Release returns zero, and verifies CreateSurface failure returns immediately without QueryInterface or Release.
tier_s_evidence: python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 0x4a88b0 passed with VC target zvideo_dd_create_surface3_from_desc, profile vc5_o2_ob0_md_facs, zero unmasked byte mismatches after 4 relocation-masked bytes and 6 trimmed VC NOP bytes.
